scope: Release preparation; newly rebuilt matching CEF distribution. Packaging and publication recorded separately.

cef.note: Newest available stable CEF checked by numeric version; Chrome security release is ahead of available CEF. No claim that all newest Chrome fixes are included.

build: Full serial Release native build with mandatory sandbox bootstrap and separate AuthTest target

live.mode: Production CEF with real MCP clients and generated profiles

checks.name: Four separate adapters, three live tabs each
Workspace and result isolation
A pending wait does not block other adapters
Page-only screenshots through real MCP image output
Replaced nodes reject stale references
Overlay hit testing rejects obscured input
Same-origin and cross-origin frames expose usable references
Shadow DOM actionability and semantics
Visual coordinates require a current screenshot
JavaScript dialogs are handled without blocking other tabs
Website JavaScript links and logout confirmations remain usable
Download namespace reports opaque scoped metadata
Idle agent handoff preserves live document, form, selection, scroll, stream and site events
Related popups transfer as one ownership group
Mid-drag handoff waits for release before changing ownership
Four workers behind one adapter, three tabs each
Disconnect/reconnect preserves page and never replays mutations

live.mode: Production CEF with real MCP clients and generated profiles

checks.name: Rendered viewport evidence excludes all hidden payloads from MCP JSON and text
Visible button text remains actionable despite hostile accessibility labels
Icon-only control uses a semantic fallback without exposing its hidden label
A changed visible label invalidates its reference even when the hidden AX name is unchanged
Shadow and frame boundaries preserve visible controls without hidden text
Hidden parent frames reject stale nested and OOPIF child references before website input
Visible generated content is represented or explicitly marked incomplete
Hidden-only text cannot satisfy observation queries or waits
Visible page instructions remain untrusted content without instruction authority

live.mode: Production CEF with real MCP clients and generated profiles

checks.name: Visible direct file input transfers only an approved opaque file
Approved file follows trusted custom upload entry
Approved file follows trusted cross-frame upload entry
A visible button without a file chooser cannot receive a file
Invalid and cross-workspace grants are denied before entry activation
A changed visible upload entry rejects its stale reference before input
A multiple-file chooser receives only the one approved file
Disabled controls and directory pickers cannot transfer files
A parent entry cannot delegate its file grant to a different frame

live.mode: Unshipped AuthTest native driver with synthetic HTTPS/removal fixtures; no physical approval

checks.name: Safe page screenshots remain available
No raw eval, CDP, cookies or storage tools
Synthetic password and OTP input events seal all observers through reveal and handoff
Native folder grants persist and upload only approved opaque file handles
Account rights remain per client across handoff
Exact credential origin enforced
GET and readonly forms reject credentials before input or submission
Opaque saved login authenticates without a model-visible credential
Four-agent handoff preserves quarantine and sends no website input
Username-first forms reuse only the exact-origin account

live.mode: Unshipped AuthTest native driver with synthetic HTTPS/removal fixtures; no physical approval

checks.name: Human autofill fills a CWL-shaped form without submission or agent account grants
Autofilled credentials remain protected from all clients through ownership handoff
Saved accounts cannot autofill a different HTTPS origin
Navigation invalidates an already offered native account selection
Replacing the bound form cannot redirect an existing autofill offer
Dismissing a native offer prevents subsequent filling
Username-first and password-only steps fill only the current phase without advancing
Locking the native vault invalidates pending offers and prevents new autofill
Lock and unlock cannot revive an accepted fill waiting for a finite action to drain

live.mode: Production CEF with real MCP clients and generated profiles

checks.name: Modern and legacy clients cannot retire each other’s workers
Twenty retired workers preserve one live drafted, selected and scrolled session
Retirement cancels queued input and releases a started finite gesture honestly
Configured global capacity spans clients and retirement frees a slot

live.mode: Unshipped AuthTest native driver with synthetic HTTPS/removal fixtures; no physical approval

checks.name: Two isolated workspaces have live data, popup, vault grant, approved file and download
Native removal revokes access and pending reads while preserving unrelated live work
Restart purges only the tombstoned profile and cannot recreate its grant
Remaining workspace cookie and local storage survive while shared files remain

live.mode: Production CEF with real MCP clients and generated profiles

checks.name: Distinct workspaces isolate persistent cookies and local storage before restart
Stored state survives a forced process stop and a second launch
A new workspace after restart does not inherit either saved session

retainedFailure.name: Normal button uses themed surface
retainedFailure.resolution: GetPixel disagreed with the actual offscreen bitmap bytes. The fixture now reads an explicit 32-bit DIB after GdiFlush, preserving the strict Light/Dark hover/leave assertions. Browser painting code unchanged.
retainedFailure.rerun: All 11 native groups passed after the test-only correction

physicalUi.note: Prior physical Dark/96-DPI visual checks belong to their recorded binary. No new physical UI claim for this updated runtime.

remainingLimits: Physical Light/Dark/System, high contrast, multiple DPI/monitor and assistive-technology matrix on the release binary remains unverified
Complete physical permission, pairing and credential-dialog/menu matrix remains manual acceptance work
Normal native Exit/restart and physical human input/dialog checks retain earlier separately hashed evidence; not repeated on this updated CEF binary
Synthetic live tests do not establish universal real-site compatibility or independent security certification
privacy: Generated profiles, accounts and files only; excludes credentials, tokens, raw page output, profile paths and screenshots
